## About Me

I am a **Professor** in the [Division of Biostatistics & Health Data Science](http://www.sph.umn.edu/academics/divisions/biostatistics/) at the [University of Minnesota School of Public Health](http://www.sph.umn.edu), where I also serve as **Program Director** for the [MPH in Public Health Data Science](http://www.sph.umn.edu/academics/degrees-programs/mph/public-health-data-science/).

My methodological research lies at the intersection of **causal inference** and **machine learning**, with a strong focus on analyzing complex, high-dimensional, and observational health datasets. 

In addition to academic research and teaching, I am co-founder and Chief Technology Officer of [Daynamica](http://www.daynamica.com), a UMN startup company providing smartphone-based data collection and analytics for understanding human activity and behavior.

---

## Background & Education

* **Ph.D. in Biostatistics** (2009) | University of Washington  
  *Dissertation supervised by Prof. Peter Gilbert at Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center.*
* **B.Sc. Joint Honours in Mathematics and Computer Science** (2004) | McGill University

Proudly Canadian 🇨🇦. Outside of work, I enjoy squash, golf, and experimenting in the kitchen.
